c74object.name: evi_saturators
c74object.digest: A GenExpr file, part of 'evieve', for using via 'require()'
c74object.description:
evi_saturators.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the 'evieve' Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_saturators.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
The evi_saturators.genexpr file also requires:
evi_adaa.genexpr
evi_interp.genexpr
About this File:
This file performs quasi resampling on all of the antiderivitive anti-aliasing saturators contained in 'evi_adaa.genexpr'. Usually adaa is enough for anti-aliasing, but sometimes it is useful to also resample the adaa for extreme use cases.
